name: breadcrumb-dropdown
title: Breadcrumb: Dropdown
description: You can compose `<BreadcrumbItem />` with a `<DropdownMenu />` to create a dropdown in the breadcrumb.

files.content:
import { Icon } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/icon";

import { RotatingChevron } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/stateful-icon";
import {
  Breadcrumb,
  BreadcrumbItem,
  BreadcrumbLink,
  BreadcrumbList,
  BreadcrumbPage,
  BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/breadcrumb";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  DropdownMenuList,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/dropdown-menu";

export function BreadcrumbDropdown() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink render={<a href="/" />}>Home</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator>
          <Icon name="dot" />
        </BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger
              render={
                <button className="group group/breadcrumb-menu-trigger flex items-center gap-1" />
              }
            >
              Components
              <RotatingChevron className="size-3.5" />
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent align="start">
              <DropdownMenuList>
                <DropdownMenuGroup>
                  <DropdownMenuItem>Documentation</DropdownMenuItem>
                  <DropdownMenuItem>Themes</DropdownMenuItem>
                  <DropdownMenuItem>GitHub</DropdownMenuItem>
                </DropdownMenuGroup>
              </DropdownMenuList>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator>
          <Icon name="dot" />
        </BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Breadcrumb</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}
